about-info-1: Hi, I'm Mohamed Imran, a B.E. Electronics & Communication Engineering student at Agni College of Technology, Chennai. I consider myself passionate about software development and AI/ML technologies since I started exploring programming and real-time hardware-software integration. I have experience in computer vision, IoT solutions, web development, and automation, constantly learning new technologies to enhance my skills.
about-info-2: I consider myself a self-taught learner who enjoys exploring new technologies daily, from AI/ML frameworks to IoT systems and web development tools that help me grow professionally and deliver innovative solutions.
about-info-3: I have hands-on experience through internships and personal projects, including gesture-based controllers, finance tracking systems, and IoT monitoring solutions. This practical experience, combined with my academic foundation, allows me to adapt to client needs and deliver efficient technology solutions.
about-skills-1: Proficient in Python for AI/ML development, automation, and backend solutions. Used extensively in computer vision projects and data processing applications.
about-skills-2: Strong foundation in CSS for responsive web design and modern UI implementations. Combined with frameworks like Bootstrap for enhanced styling.
about-skills-3: Experienced in JavaScript for frontend development, interactive web applications, and automation workflows. Essential for React and Angular projects.
about-skills-4: Skilled in Java programming with object-oriented design principles. Completed masterclass certification and applied in various development projects.
about-skills-5: Proficient in React framework for building dynamic, component-based web applications with modern JavaScript ES6+ features and state management.
about-skills-6: Experienced with Angular framework for developing scalable web applications with TypeScript, component architecture, and enterprise-level solutions.
about-skills-7: Knowledgeable in C programming for embedded systems development, Arduino projects, and low-level hardware-software integration solutions.
about-skills-8: Proficient in SQL for database management, data analysis, and backend development. Essential for data-driven application development.
about-skills-9: Experienced with TensorFlow and OpenCV for machine learning model development, computer vision applications, and AI solution implementation.
about-skills-10: Proficient in Canva for creating professional graphics, social media content, presentations, and visual design elements for web and marketing materials.
about-skills-11: Experienced with n8n for workflow automation, API integrations, and creating efficient business process automation solutions with visual workflow builder.
services-questions-1: What is a responsive web page?
services-questions-p1: It is that page that is capable of adapting to any device where it is viewed, such as cell phones, tablets, laptops, without losing appearance or usability.
services-questions-2: What is a Domain and a Hosting?
services-questions-p2: Both are essential elements of a website. In short, the domain name is the address of the web page, while the hosting provides the space and resources necessary to launch the website.
services-questions-p3: Regular maintenance of your website allows you to attract and retain customers with new information, new products and services, in addition to helping you maintain or improve your ranking in Google.
services-questions-p4: You can pay online by credit or debit cards and payments by transfers.
